summary: Replaces the experimental Path From Shape TC command with a new CAM_PathShape operation that has its own object class and view provider, a renamed menu entry, and a much larger property set including CycleTime, CoolantMode, StepDepth, DualDirection, StartPoint and HandleMultipleFeatures.

pages.reason: Path/Op/Gui/PathShape.py replaces PathShapeTC.py: command renamed CAM_PathShapeTC -> CAM_PathShape (menu text no longer 'Path From Shape TC'), property set rebuilt into Base/Tool/Feed/StartPoint/Curves/Path/Sorting/Gcode/Depth groups with new CycleTime, CoolantMode, HorizFeed/VertFeed, StartPoint/UseStartPoint, DualDirection, SafetyFinish, RetractAxis, HandleMultipleFeatures, PathParams, EmitPreamble, StartDepth, StepDepth; old OpToolDiameter, UserLabel, FeedRate and FeedRateVertical are gone; a ViewProvider is added so the object now has a task panel and multiple wires are processed
InitGui.py: experimental prepcmdlist entry changes from CAM_PathShapeTC to CAM_PathShape, so the Supplemental Commands listing and its menu label need the new name
InitGui.py: the command gated behind experimentalFeaturesEnabled() is now CAM_PathShape rather than CAM_PathShapeTC; the experimental-features list should name the new command
